question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Revive
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Destroy'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Revive', **which signifies regaining life, consciousness, or strength; revitalizing something. **(पुनर्जीवित करना).**

 
 
• **Example:** The rain helped to** revive** the wilted plants.
 
 
 
• The correct antonym is** 'Destroy', **which means causing so much damage to something that it no longer exists or cannot be repaired. **(नष्ट करना or बरबाद करना).**
 
 
• **Example:** The earthquake **destroyed **several buildings in the city.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is** "option 3".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• **'Revolve'** describes turn or cause to turn in a circle, particularly in a constant angular relation to another point or line. **(घूमना or चक्कर लगाना).**
 
• **'Rejuvenate'** is a synonym of 'Revive', meaning to make (someone or something) look or feel younger, fresher, or more lively.** (नवजीवन प्रदान करना).**
 
• **'Incline' **means to feel willing or favorably disposed toward (an action, belief, or attitude).** (झुकना or इरादा करना).**
